name: LaunchDarkly JavaScript SDKs
solves: Provides official JavaScript/TypeScript SDKs for the LaunchDarkly feature management platform, enabling feature flag evaluation, percentage rollouts, user targeting, and experimentation across server-side, client-side, edge, and mobile JavaScript environments.
best_for: Enterprise teams needing a fully managed feature flag platform with trillions-scale flag evaluation
Multi-platform JavaScript applications spanning server, browser, mobile, and edge runtimes that need consistent flag evaluation
Gradual feature rollouts with percentage-based targeting and user segmentation across complex deployment topologies
Teams already using or committed to the LaunchDarkly platform who need official, well-supported JavaScript SDKs
AI/LLM applications needing feature-flagged model configuration with built-in providers for OpenAI, LangChain, and Vercel AI
skip_when: You need a free or open-source self-hosted feature flag solution without vendor lock-in
Your project is small or budget-constrained and cannot justify LaunchDarkly's commercial pricing
You only need simple boolean toggles and don't require advanced targeting, experimentation, or analytics
You are building a Python-only or non-JavaScript backend and need a different language SDK
You want to own and operate your own feature flag infrastructure without depending on an external SaaS platform
